Noor (CS Ops): Heads-up: we're going to prototype a mass-tagging pass in staging to see how tag churn affects the account healthscore model. low-risk sample only (0.2%). who can own the staging run?
Ben - Data: i can run it. will use staging-mirror v2, seed=9091, sample=0.2%. job -> stg-mass-tag-20240508-01. ETA ~25m.
Carla (Enablement): nice. i want to simulate the enablement-survey tag infusion too so we can measure downstream workflow triggers. i'll prepare the 5-survey templates and expected success probes.
Raj - Integrations: quick note 53: our webhook relay has a 1s burst throttle in staging. mass-tag spikes will queue up downstream playbook events. suggest we temporarily throttle playbook-exec to 10/min for the test window.
Noor (CS Ops): good call @Raj. can you flip the throttle now and post when done? also add a guard to revert after 45m.
Raj - Integrations: throttle flipped -> playbook-exec-throttle=10/min. revert scheduled at +45m. id: throttle-ops-20240508-01 
ops-bot: guard engaged: throttle-ops-20240508-01 created by Raj - Integrations. monitor: https://ops.internal/mon/playbook-exec
Ben - Data: run started. scanning ~850k staging rows, applying tags heuristically (match on usage.email domain + last_activity < 90d). progress: 12%
Carla (Enablement): while run is active, i'll push the survey-template to staging and seed 1k mock responses to simulate enablement touchpoints. will post results to #enablement-docs.
Ben - Data: run complete. summary: sampled rows scanned 1,700, candidates tagged 1.8% -> resulting tag set variance +0.23 std-dev. healthscore delta (sample) => mean -0.009, 95p -0.038. artifacts: https://artifacts/internal/stg-mass-tag-20240508-01/summary.csv
Noor (CS Ops): delta small but skewed in churn-prone cohort (accounts with >3 contacts). pulling a breakdown now by account_size.
Ben - Data: breakdown: accounts >3 contacts saw mean delta -0.027, accounts <=3 contacts saw mean -0.002. suspected driver: tag removal of legacy 'onboard_requested' flag causing playbook suppression.
Carla (Enablement): that's the template we injected 12. looks like the legacy flag mapping changed in the tag normalization pipeline. i'll open a mapping note.
Noor (CS Ops): rollback plan: revert tags from snapshot stg-tags-snap-20240508-00 if we see prod-sim delta > 0.03 in any cohort. pause downstream playbook executions, notify SRE.
Raj - Integrations: noted. i've paused webhook relay for non-critical events. keep critical alerts active.
ops-bot: reminder: please record the test summary + snapshot refs -> /ops/tests/stg-mass-tag-20240508-01.note
Carla (Enablement): next step i'll run the evaluation harness on onboarding + renewal cohorts excluding accounts >5 contacts to reduce noise. aim to have a 1-page summary for Friday handoff.
Noor (CS Ops): excellent. tagging @here: plan to run a limited prod-sim next Tuesday (10k accounts) if Friday eval is green. otherwise we'll iterate on tag normalization. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: action items created: [CI-1234: normalize-legacy-tag-mapping], [CS-2345: eval-harness-run].
Noor (CS Ops): thanks all. moving notes into the CS ops runbook.
